messages:
Alex: Heads-up — planning a late-afternoon deploy for runtime tweaks, target 18:00 PT. Need smoke + rollback owners and final ack. Can people confirm by 17:30 PT?
Checklist:
- owners (smoke/rollback)
- smoke tests (functional + perf)
- rollback plan verified
- DB/flag sanity check
Runbook: https://intra.redwood/runbooks/deploy-runtime-tweaks

Maria: I can own smoke tests. I'll run perf smoke (10m) and quick functional checks. Ping me at start. :thumbsup:

Sam: I'll own rollback. Rollback command I tested: `kubectl rollout undo deployment/runtime-service --to-revision=stable-2026-03-17`
I'll be on standby in #eng-oncall.

Kevin: Are there DB migrations or flag flips in this PR? I saw a flag change in https://git.redwood/repo/pull/4123 — we should not flip without QA.

Priya: Can we do a 1% canary for ~15m then widen? Metrics to watch: p50/p95 latency, error rate, token throughput. Also check KV cache hit rate.

Alex: Yes — plan: 1% for 15m, observe 10m, then 10% for 10m, then widen. Targets: p50 < 30ms, p95 < 200ms, errors < 0.5%.
Quick smoke steps:
1) Functional: `curl -X POST https://api.redwood/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' -d '{"input":"smoke test"}'`
2) Perf: `bash tools/smoke/run_smoke.sh --endpoint https://api.redwood/v1/generate --rps 20 --duration 60`
3) Check KV cache: dashboard -> runtime/cache/hit-rate

Maria: Got it. I'll post results here. ETA: start smoke at 18:15 PT.

Sam: Rollback tested on staging earlier today; command works. Standby on pager.

deploy-bot: Reminder: deploy window opens in 10m. Canary slot reserved for eng-releases.

Maria: Smoke run complete — functional ✅, perf p50=25ms p95=180ms, errors=0.12%. KV cache hit: 78%. :tada:

Kevin: LGTM from infra side. No DB migration, feature flag remains off.

Priya: 1% canary triggered. Watching dashboards (latency, errors, token throughput).

deploy-bot: Canary complete (15m). No alerts in the window. Rolling to 10%.

Alex: All clear so far. Widen to 50% in 5m, then full after 10m if stable. Thanks everyone for quick responses.

Maria: Ack — will keep watching for 30m and report any regressions.
